name.cite: EDM 2026 §9.3.4.1 Table 9-3 p.351, row 2, column Small Trees

table_9_3.note: "Tree size classifications are approximate and intended as guidelines" (p.352); Columnar is never assigned from this table

city.match_rule: genus == SORBUS and first species word == ARIA; hybrid marker 'X' ignored; any cultivar

height_m.note: City height_m values are class midpoints (4.6, 7.6, 10.7 …), not measurements

form.note: assigned by the author from horticultural common knowledge; replaced when a cited reference is entered

crown_width.note: crown spread is not published by the City; ratio by form (round .6, oval .5, vase .7, columnar .3, conical .45, weeping .8) until a cited value replaces it

reference.collection: Root System Drawings (Wageningen University & Research, Image Collections)
reference.publication: Kutschera, L.; Lichtenegger, E., Wurzelatlas mitteleuropäischer Waldbäume und Sträucher. Graz, Stuttgart: Leopold Stocker Verlag, 2002 (2. Aufl. 2013), 604 p.
reference.reading_rule: per plate the atlas records the excavated plant's root depth (D root) and root-system diameter; the mean ratio depth / diameter over plates of plants at least 5 m tall (all plates when none is) gives the drawn habit: >= 0.40 tap, 0.15–0.40 heart, < 0.15 flat
reference.rights: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 for the Wurzelatlas information and illustrations (source quoted in full, non-commercial, publisher informed); the scans of the original drawings need the heirs' permission (wurzelforschung.at)

root_form.note: root habit read from the atlas plates (Kutschera & Lichtenegger 2002) for the drawing only; the plates are excavated Central-European specimens: not a measured extent on the site; roots are still drawn only in the soil the rule credits

guidelines_2011.cite: City of Vancouver Street Tree Guidelines 2011, Preferred Street Tree Species List pp.12–14: not listed

drawn_height_m.basis: p90 of City height_m over 631 trees of this species
drawn_height_m.note: nine in ten City trees of this species are this tall or shorter; class midpoints, not a mature size

section.source: V-10880 (2819 W 11th Av, Kitsilano) front boulevard under R30, an ordinary 20 m residential section; reference only

need_box_in_library.note: reference only; on a site the box takes the site's band section

model.note: trunk cylinder + faceted crown hull, no branching; normalized to height 1.0 and scaled by the tree's height on the page
